items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Michael O'Groen Schumer' in a list of groups/people; Interviewee does not mention him personally or describe a relationship.

ctx.x: No, no. No, I've never wore that, no. I don't know, like the Masonics and anything? No, no, no. In the old days who wore aprons?
What kind of aprons did they have? Did the Masonics or the others? The Masonic and our art fellas and Michael O'Groen Schumer and those people like that. What dance?

Oh no, on Labor Day, Labor Day Parade. Labor Day Parade was a parade. That was another nice parade. They'd have all the bands out. All the bands. They were bands they could get. They could see a parade. And those things were never coming back no more. Where would the parade start and end up? Or like the Labor Day Parade? Well, Labor Day Parade, well, I'll tell you as far as I know about it, Labor Day Parade would start at the River Canal, right on that part. And they'd come down, come around Cloud Street. I mean,…
